_doc: Derek's taste rules (the tool's defaults are neutral; this is one named style). Infantry scaled to their own eye height (sole to pupil line; Guardsman 28 mm, per-unit targets in the game profiles), bases 25 mm round with a gentle 0.7 mm dome, a very gradual texture (+-0.12 mm, ~1.8 mm features), no rocks/pebbles/grooves and no ground mound round the feet; each planted boot pressed ~0.4 mm into the surface (a shallow pocket fading out over ~1 mm). One watertight STL plus a cut plan, no automatic split. No normal-map relief on skin.
